historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: EPS 5yr CAGR (22.41%) diverges 75% from equity 5yr CAGR (5.58%); EPS 3yr CAGR (45.35%) more so. Both are artifacts of the FY2022 trough base (EPS JPY31.77 at a 1.8% operating margin), not a step-change in earnings power. Reported and owner FCF CAGRs are negative because FY2021 (low-capex COVID recovery, FCF JPY22.5bn) and FY2024 (working-capital-favourable, JPY26.4bn) are unusually high endpoints against capex-heavy FY2026 (JPY8.5bn). Equity CAGR is used as the growth anchor; the projection itself is a component build from FY2027 guidance, not an extrapolated CAGR.
historical_growth.notes: Unchanged from the 2026-08-14 build: the annual history (FY2017-FY2026) is the same; H1 FY2027 adds no annual data point. Owner FCF is close to reported FCF every year because SBC = 0; the gap is only the interest/dividend strip (JPY0.1-1.9bn/yr). FCF is structurally volatile across the capex cycle (10yr range JPY0.3bn-26.4bn), which is why the forward path is built from components.

scenario_narratives.base: FY2027 is the guided investment trough (OP JPY30.0bn, 4.6% margin, reaffirmed at H1 despite -17.7% YoY operating profit): rising labour, depreciation and Mirai spending plus a persistent net price-down outrun volume and cost-reduction gains. From FY2028 Smart System/digital-key and HMI content growth (Smart System guided +9.6%) offsets shrinking Key Lock and Steering Wheel lines, revenue grows 1.5-2.3%/yr and the operating margin climbs to 6.0% by FY2036 -- partial, not full, delivery of TRV2030's 7%. Capex tapers from the 5.1-5.5% peak to 4%. The market keeps paying its 10-year average 2.66x EV/EBITDA; the value is mostly the JPY94bn net cash and securities plus a modest, capped earnings stream.
scenario_narratives.bull: TRV2030 lands on plan: 7% operating margin by FY2031 on JPY700bn sales as digital-key/UWB wins outside Toyota and Hidden Switch content lift revenue 3.5-4.2%/yr, price recovery fully offsets price-down and tariffs, and the TSE PBR-reform capital-return programme (JPY120 dividend held through a trough year, 2.9% buyback in FY2027 after 5.3% cancelled in FY2026) keeps the count shrinking. Exit multiple = the 10-year maximum 3.12x EV/EBITDA, i.e. the stock is re-rated to the top of its own range, not beyond it.
scenario_narratives.bear: H1 FY2027 was the warning: Q2 operating margin 5.9% vs 8.3% a year earlier, ordinary profit -44% YoY. A formal guidance cut follows, Toyota volumes soften, fixed costs stay, price-down pressure goes unrecovered and the yen strengthens; revenue shrinks in FY2027-28 then crawls at <1%, operating margin settles at 3.5-4.2% (the FY2022-23 range). Capital returns continue (the balance sheet allows it) but the market pays only its COVID-low 1.67x EV/EBITDA for the earnings stream.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Tokai Rika is a deep-value / net-cash / capital-return story, not a growth compounder. Net cash plus liquid securities of ~JPY94bn and investment securities of JPY19bn, against JPY23bn of NCI, cover ~40% of the ~JPY234bn market cap; the stock has traded at 0.45-0.89x P/B (10yr avg 0.65x) and 1.67-3.12x EV/EBITDA (avg 2.66x) for a decade. The DCF starts from the reaffirmed FY2027 trough guidance and builds ten years of components toward partial TRV2030 delivery, and the terminal value is capped at the stock's own historical EV/EBITDA rather than Gordon growth, because Gordon at 9.5%/1.5% implies ~4.7x EBITDA, which the market has never paid for this name. The uncapped Gordon value is reported as the memo price of the TSE PBR-reform re-rating thesis. The 2026-11-02 update refreshes the anchors (30-Sep-2026 balance sheet, 29-Oct-2026 2.6m-share buyback), re-judges only the FY2027-28 cash tax rate on the H1 evidence, and corrects four method items against the owner-fcf checklist (working-capital sign, matching-asset bridge, NCI, single WACC); every later-year operating driver is carried unchanged and the reconciliation bridge attributes each move.
valuation_philosophy.re_rating_memo: Uncapped Gordon terminal value at 9.5% WACC / 1.5% terminal growth implies roughly 4.7x terminal EV/EBITDA (10-yr max paid: 3.12x). The gap between the capped house value and the uncapped Gordon value is the explicit price of the re-rating thesis; see the generated DCF JSON's sensitivity grid for the Gordon-bound values and the prior build's exit-multiple grid (each full turn of exit EV/EBITDA was worth ~JPY365/share).
key_risks_to_valuation: Formal FY2027 guidance cut if H2 does not deliver the implied recovery (H1 OP -17.7%, Q2 ordinary profit -44%); would move Y1 margin below 4.6% and the bear weight to 30-35%
Toyota-group concentration (~74% of sales): any sourcing or volume change dominates every driver
Structural net price-down (customer price-down > recovery every year) and incomplete US tariff pass-through keep the margin ramp slower than TRV2030 assumes
EV/digital-key transition erodes Key Lock, Shift Lever and Steering Wheel faster than Smart System content replaces it
FX: FY2027 guidance assumes USD150 in H2; a stronger yen cuts translated overseas profit (Americas and Asia generate nearly all operating profit)
Governance: FY2021-25 deferred-tax restatement and material weakness; a further restatement would hit the 0.7x P/B story directly
Terminal-multiple assumption: the valuation assumes the market keeps paying ~2.7x EV/EBITDA; if it de-rates to the 1.67x low the base case loses ~JPY360/share

inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 Kessan Tanshin cash-flow statement carries no share-based payment line; StockBasedComp is 0.0 across FY2017-FY2026 in Metrics.csv. Verified nil, not a data gap. The employee share-remuneration trust (1,560,800 shares, disclosed 2026-10-28) is expensed through SG&A as points are granted and its shares sit in treasury; they are NOT added to the count because the cost is already inside the operating margin (charge once).
inputs.buyback_note: FY2026 financing cash flow shows purchases of treasury stock of JPY0 (the FY2026 5m-share cancellation retired shares already held). On 2026-10-28 the board resolved a ToSTNeT-3 repurchase of up to 2.6m shares / JPY8.6bn (29-Oct to 31-Dec-2026) with cancellation. The company's FY2027 EPS forecast of JPY238.06 on JPY20.0bn profit implies a ~84.0m weighted average count, which only ties if the full 2.6m fill on 29-Oct is assumed (85.195m x 7/12 + 82.595m x 5/12 = 84.1m), so the buyback is treated as executed at the 28-Oct close of JPY2,911: shares -2.6m, cash -JPY7,569m.
inputs.share_count_basis: Issued 89,234,171 less treasury 4,038,918 at 2026-09-30 = 85,195,253, less the 2.6m-share ToSTNeT-3 repurchase of 29-Oct-2026 = 82,595,253. No dilutive securities (diluted EPS not reported). The -0.5%/yr drift is the PRIOR base-case judgment retained unchanged: with SBC nil there is no dilution to cover, and management is cancelling repurchased shares under TRV2030 (5m in FY2026, 2.6m in FY2027 = 2.9%), so -0.5%/yr remains conservative against the realised pace. The cash spent on future repurchases is not deducted from the flows, which modestly overstates value (~JPY1.2bn/yr at -0.5%); at a price near intrinsic value the two effects roughly offset.
inputs.cash_note: Cash = cash and deposits JPY76,214m + marketable securities JPY35,292m (both 2026-09-30 semi-annual balance sheet) - JPY7,569m ToSTNeT-3 repurchase = JPY103,937m. The prior build used the cash-flow-statement 'cash and cash equivalents' (JPY93,757m at 2026-03-31), which excluded ~JPY24bn of fixed deposits and securities maturing beyond three months even though the interest they earn was stripped from the flows; the matching-asset rule (owner-fcf-adaptations (d)) requires the full liquid financial-asset line. The interim does not carry a cash-flow statement, so the CF-basis figure is not available at 30-Sep anyway. Total debt = JPY10,000m bonds (reclassified to current, due within one year). Finance-lease liabilities are not disclosed separately in the interim (inside 'Others'); the JPY627m/yr lease principal is charged in the flows instead (see lease_treatment).
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2026 interest income JPY1,307m + dividend income JPY365m = JPY1,672m (FY2026 column of the consolidated statement of income; the prior build read the FY2025 column's JPY623m dividend figure by mistake, JPY1,889m). Net cash (~JPY94bn) is >10x the FCF base so both are stripped; the assets that earn them (cash, marketable securities, investment securities) are all in the bridge. H1 FY2027 run-rate (754 + 92 = 846 for six months) is consistent.
inputs.wacc_rationale: JPY-built: 10y JGB ~1.6%, Japan ERP ~5.5%, beta ~1.3 for a Toyota-group Tier-1 supplier with 74% single-group concentration -> cost of equity ~8.8%; the company is net cash so WACC = cost of equity, rounded up to 9.5% to stay inside the house ~9-10% range for JPY keiretsu industrials. ONE rate across all three scenarios (owner-fcf-adaptations (f)): the prior build used 8.45/9.5/10.95 per scenario on top of probability weights and per-scenario terminal caps, which charged cyclicality three times; unified here and bridged in the reconciliation.
inputs.lease_treatment: J-GAAP filer: operating leases are expensed inside operating profit already. Finance-lease principal (JPY627m FY2026, 'Lease liabilities paid' in financing) is charged inside the flows as lease_cost_pct_path = 0.10% of revenue, and lease liabilities are therefore EXCLUDED from net debt (treatment B). Immaterial either way (~JPY7/share), but charged once rather than not at all.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (segment margins include the ~6.5% of profit attributable to non-controlling interests, JPY2,178m in FY2026); NCI is charged ONCE by deducting the NCI book value of JPY23,367m (2026-09-30) in the equity bridge. The prior build neither made the flows attributable nor deducted NCI; fixed here and bridged.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical: keiretsu suppliers'), engine route, unchanged from the 2026-08-14 build; MEMORY.md has no entry for this ticker. UPDATE, not a rebuild: the H1 FY2027 release (2026-10-28) left full-year guidance unchanged (sales JPY650.0bn +0.8%, OP JPY30.0bn -15.8%, net JPY20.0bn -32.1%), and the prior base case ALREADY started from that guidance year (Y1 growth 0.8%, OP margin 4.615%), so the Y1 revenue and margin drivers are not re-judged. What the H1 evidence does touch: (1) the cash tax rate for FY2027-28 (H1 effective rate 38% on a smaller pre-tax base; guided full year ~33% = (33.0 - 22.0)/33.0 incl. NCI) -> Y1 33%, Y2 31%, then the prior 30.5%; (2) the anchors (cash, securities, bonds now current, share count after the 29-Oct repurchase); (3) the price. Later-year growth, margin, D&A and capex paths are DELIBERATELY UNCHANGED: H1 OP margin (5.3%) is still above the full-year guide (4.6%), H1 progress on ordinary profit (53.5%) matches the 5-year seasonal average, and the net-profit collapse (-49%) is below-EBIT noise (FX loss JPY898m vs a JPY1,566m gain, no repeat of last year's JPY2,566m securities gain). Evidence that WOULD move them: a formal FY2027 guidance cut, FY2027 actual OP below ~JPY27bn, or a TRV2030 margin-target walk-back. Four METHOD corrections against the owner-fcf checklist are applied and each is bridged separately: working-capital sign (prior +8% capture read as a cash inflow while its own note said 'cash use'; receivables + inventory - payables = JPY125bn = 19% of revenue, so growth consumes cash: -15%), matching-asset bridge (investment securities), NCI deduction, single WACC. TERMINAL: the prior's own-multiple discipline is retained -- terminal value is capped at the stock's historical EV/EBITDA (base 2.66x 10-yr average, bull 3.12x 10-yr max, bear 1.67x 10-yr min), expressed to the engine as the equivalent multiple of terminal-year owner FCF (terminal_cap_multiple), because Gordon growth at 9.5%/1.5% implies ~4.7x EBITDA, a multiple this stock has never traded at. The uncapped house-Gordon figure is reported as the re-rating memo in valuation_philosophy. SBC-zero market: house and street coincide, band_position is null.

bear.ebitda_margin_note: UNCHANGED paths (OP margin 3.8% -> 4.2%: Toyota volumes soften, price-down persists without recovery, EV transition erodes Key Lock/Shift Lever/Steering Wheel faster than Smart System compensates; margin never recovers above the FY2022-23 trough range). WACC unified at 9.5% (prior 10.95%) -- the bear is charged through its flows, its 1.0% terminal growth and its 1.67x cap, not a fourth time through the discount rate.
bear.terminal_cap_note: Cap = 10-year MINIMUM EV/EBITDA paid (1.67x, FY2020 COVID low). Translated to the FCF multiple on the built projection.

base.growth_note: UNCHANGED from 2026-08-14. Y1 (FY2027) = company guidance +0.8% (reaffirmed 2026-10-28; H1 +5.8% implies H2 -4.0% YoY on the guided USD150 H2 rate); Y2+ gradual Smart System/HMI content recovery decelerating to 1.5% terminal, consistent with mature Japanese auto-parts demand.
base.ebitda_margin_note: UNCHANGED. Y1 = guided OP margin 4.615% (JPY30.0bn / JPY650.0bn) + D&A 3.9% (guidance flags rising depreciation; FY2026 actual 3.62%). OP margin recovers to 6.0% by Y10 -- PARTIAL progress against the TRV2030 FY2031 target of 7%, reflecting the structural net price-down drag the company discloses every year (FY2026: -JPY12.4bn price-down vs +JPY10.6bn recovery). H1 FY2027 OP margin of 5.3% sits above the Y1 assumption, so the H1 miss does not move the path.
base.capex_note: UNCHANGED. Y1 = guided JPY33.0bn / JPY650.0bn; tapers from the TRV2030 investment-cycle peak (FY2026 5.46%) toward ~4.0% maintenance.
base.cash_tax_rate_note: RE-JUDGED for Y1-Y2 on the H1 FY2027 evidence: H1 booked a 38% effective rate (JPY6,784m on JPY17,646m, estimated-annual-rate method on a smaller base) and the full-year guide implies ~33% ((ordinary 33.0 - profit 20.0 - NCI ~2.0)/33.0). Y1 33.0%, Y2 31.0%, then the prior 30.5% (FY2026 actual 31.0%, Japanese statutory ~30-31%).
base.wc_capture_note: SIGN CORRECTED. The prior file carried +8% while describing it as 'a modest cash use as revenue grows' -- in this engine a positive capture is a cash INFLOW on the revenue change. Tokai Rika is a manufacturer: receivables JPY95bn + inventories JPY86bn - payables JPY56bn = JPY125bn net working capital = 19% of revenue at 2026-09-30, so growth consumes cash. -15% capture (a little under the full 19%, as some inventory is structural and does not scale 1:1).
base.terminal_cap_note: Cap = the 10-year AVERAGE EV/EBITDA actually paid for this stock (2.66x, FY-end prices FY2017-FY2026, range 1.67x-3.12x), translated into the engine's multiple of terminal-year owner FCF (terminal_cap_multiple = 2.66 x EBITDA_N / FCF_N, calibrated on the built projection). Gordon at 9.5%/1.5% would imply ~4.7x EBITDA, above anything the market has paid in a decade; the cap binds in every scenario and the uncapped figure is the re-rating memo.

bull.ebitda_margin_note: UNCHANGED paths (OP margin 5.0% -> 7.0% by FY2031 = TRV2030 fully achieved, 7.3% by Y10, plus D&A). Y1 tax re-judged to 33% like base; Y2+ prior path.
bull.terminal_cap_note: Cap = 10-year MAXIMUM EV/EBITDA paid (3.12x, FY2023 FY-end) -- even the bull case does not pay a multiple never observed. Translated to the FCF multiple on the built projection.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 7.479x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: UNCHANGED from 2026-08-14: 25/50/25 rather than the house 15/50/35 because ~74% of sales depend on one customer group (Toyota) and Tier-1 pricing power is nil, so the bear weight is already elevated and the bull trimmed. The H1 FY2027 miss raises the odds of a formal guidance cut but does not yet justify moving further: H1 ordinary-profit progress (53.5%) matches the five-year seasonal average and guidance was reaffirmed. A guidance cut in Q3 would move bear to 30-35%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
